     1→# Plan: Agent Protocol Stack — A2UI + AG-UI Integration + TDD Fix
     2→
     3→## Context
     4→
     5→Two converging problems:
     6→1. **Immediate:** Sound is broken, narration doesn't work, no tests verify the webapp
     7→2. **Strategic:** Google just released A2UI (declarative agent-driven UI) and a 6-protocol agent stack guide. Cohezion already implements MCP + A2A. Adding A2UI + AG-UI makes us one of the first full-stack agent protocol implementations.
     8→
     9→The strategic move solves the immediate problem: A2UI's declarative component catalog makes the Genesis experience **testable by agents** (the component tree is JSON, not opaque WebGL). AG-UI's typed event streaming replaces our ad-hoc SSE/WebSocket mix with a standard protocol.
    10→
    11→## What Cohezion Already Has
    12→
    13→| Protocol | Status | Implementation |
    14→|----------|--------|---------------|
    15→| MCP | Strong | 41+ tools, cloud-vault-mcp, compound-mcp |
    16→| A2A | In Progress | 7 agents, `/.well-known/agent.json` endpoint |
    17→| A2UI | Gap | Genesis webapp uses React/R3F directly, not declarative |
    18→| AG-UI | Gap | SSE universe stream exists but isn't typed to AG-UI spec |
    19→
    20→## Phase 1: Fix What's Broken NOW (TDD, 1 session)
    21→
    22→Before protocol integration, fix the broken features. Test-first.
    23→
    24→### 1.1 Write Playwright tests using MCP browser tools
    25→Use the Playwright MCP tools we already have to test interactively:
    26→- Navigate to /genesis
    27→- Verify "click to begin" is visible
    28→- Click canvas → verify temperature decreases
    29→- Check for narration text overlay
    30→- Check console for JS errors
    31→- Toggle sound/narration buttons
    32→
    33→### 1.2 Fix narration
    34→- Read the current narration overlay code
    35→- Verify `narration.currentText` is being set (add debug logging)
    36→- Fix: the overlay may have wrong z-index or be hidden by canvas
    37→- Test: Playwright checks for visible narration text after click
    38→
    39→### 1.3 Fix sound
    40→- Read useSonification.ts cinematic methods
    41→- Problem: likely too loud, wrong frequencies, harsh timbres
    42→- Fix: reduce all volumes by 10dB, soften attack/release, use warmer waveforms
    43→- Test: verify no JS errors when sound is toggled on
    44→
    45→### 1.4 Stop API 404 spam
    46→- The set-temperature endpoint doesn't exist — remove the API call
    47→- Local Landau math already handles everything
    48→- Test: zero console errors on genesis page
    49→
    50→## Phase 2: A2UI Component Catalog (2-3 sessions)
    51→
    52→Define the Genesis experience as a **declarative component catalog** following A2UI spec.
    53→
    54→### 2.1 Clone and study A2UI
    55→```bash
    56→git clone https://github.com/google/A2UI.git ~/dev/A2UI
    57→```
    58→Study the 18 component primitives, the JSON schema, and the rendering pipeline.
    59→
    60→### 2.2 Define Cohezion's component catalog
    61→Map existing React components to A2UI declarative format:
    62→
    63→```json
    64→{
    65→  "catalog": {
    66→    "cohezion-void-sphere": {
    67→      "type": "three-scene",
    68→      "props": ["scale", "glowIntensity", "dustCount"],
    69→      "events": ["onClick"]
    70→    },
    71→    "cohezion-explosion": {
    72→      "type": "three-particles",
    73→      "props": ["particleCount", "phase", "fabricColors"],
    74→      "events": ["onPhaseChange"]
    75→    },
    76→    "cohezion-bloch-sphere": {
    77→      "type": "three-interactive",
    78→      "props": ["theta", "phi", "showTrail"],
    79→      "events": ["onDrag", "onRelease"]
    80→    },
    81→    "cohezion-narration": {
    82→      "type": "overlay-text",
    83→      "props": ["text", "duration", "ttsEnabled"],
    84→      "events": ["onComplete"]
    85→    },
    86→    "cohezion-sound-engine": {
    87→      "type": "audio",
    88→      "props": ["phase", "coherence", "temperature", "muted"],
    89→      "events": ["onPhaseTransition"]
    90→    }
    91→  }
    92→}
    93→```
    94→
    95→### 2.3 Genesis Experience Script
    96→Replace imperative GenesisScene.tsx with a **declarative timeline**:
    97→
    98→```json
    99→{
   100→  "experience": "genesis-cosmogony",
   101→  "scenes": [
   102→    {
   103→      "id": "void",
   104→      "duration": null,
   105→      "trigger": "click",
   106→      "components": [
   107→        {"type": "cohezion-void-sphere", "scale": 0.05, "dustCount": 100},
   108→        {"type": "cohezion-narration", "text": "In the beginning..."}
   109→      ]
   110→    },
   111→    {
   112→      "id": "explosion",
   113→      "duration": 2000,
   114→      "components": [
   115→        {"type": "cohezion-explosion", "phase": "exploding", "particleCount": 500},
   116→        {"type": "cohezion-sound-engine", "phase": "explosion"},
   117→        {"type": "cohezion-narration", "text": "From the void, symmetry crystallizes..."}
   118→      ]
   119→    }
   120→  ]
   121→}
   122→```
   123→
   124→This is **testable** — an agent can validate the JSON structure, verify transitions, and check that each scene references valid catalog components.
   125→
   126→### 2.4 A2UI Renderer
   127→Build a thin rendering layer that reads the experience script and instantiates the React/R3F components from the catalog. This bridges A2UI's declarative format to our existing Three.js infrastructure.
   128→
   129→## Phase 3: AG-UI Event Streaming (1-2 sessions)
   130→
   131→Replace the ad-hoc SSE/WebSocket mix with AG-UI typed events.
   132→
   133→### 3.1 Define event types
   134→Map our existing events to AG-UI format:
   135→- `TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT` → narration text
   136→- `TOOL_CALL_START` → cosmogony phase transition starting
   137→- `TOOL_CALL_RESULT` → phase transition complete with new state
   138→- `STATE_DELTA` → universe tick (coherence, temperature, CA state)
   139→- `RUN_FINISHED` → cosmogony animation complete
   140→
   141→### 3.2 AG-UI SSE endpoint
   142→Replace `/api/universe/stream` with an AG-UI-compatible SSE endpoint that emits typed events. Use `ag_ui_adk` or implement the event format directly.
   143→
   144→### 3.3 Frontend AG-UI consumer
   145→Replace useUniverseStream.ts with an AG-UI client that understands typed events and routes them to the correct components.
   146→
   147→## Phase 4: Update CLAUDE.md Protocol Stack
   148→
   149→Update the protocol table in CLAUDE.md to show full coverage:
   150→
   151→| Protocol | Status | Implementation |
   152→|----------|--------|---------------|
   153→| MCP | Strong | 41+ tools |
   154→| A2A | Strong | 7 agents + agent.json |
   155→| A2UI | Strong | Genesis component catalog + declarative experience scripts |
   156→| AG-UI | Strong | Typed SSE events for all Genesis interactions |
   157→
   158→## Verification
   159→
   160→### Phase 1 (immediate)
   161→- Playwright: narration text visible after click
   162→- Playwright: zero console errors on all tabs
   163→- Manual: sound is pleasant (ambient, not harsh)
   164→
   165→### Phase 2 (A2UI)
   166→- Component catalog JSON validates against A2UI schema

   170→### Phase 3 (AG-UI)
   171→- SSE endpoint emits AG-UI typed events
   172→- Frontend renders correctly from typed events
   173→- Events are structured enough for agent testing/verification
   174→
   175→## Priority
   176→
   177→1. **Phase 1** — fix broken features NOW (sound, narration, errors)
   178→2. **Phase 2** — A2UI component catalog (makes the Genesis experience testable + protocol-compliant)
   179→3. **Phase 3** — AG-UI streaming (completes the protocol stack)

/** Void quote overlay — pulsing opacity */
function VoidQuote({ active }: { active: boolean }) {
  const [opacity, setOpacity] = useState(0.3);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    let frameId: number;
    const animate = () => {
      const t = performance.now() / 1000;
      setOpacity(0.3 + Math.sin(t * 0.8) * 0.15);
      frameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    };
    frameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
  }, [active]);

  if (!active) return null;

  return (
    <Html position={[0, -1.5, 0]} center>
      <div
        className="font-mono text-sm text-center select-none max-w-xs"
        style={{
          color: "#444",
          opacity,
          transition: "opacity 0.1s",
        }}
      >
        In the beginning, there was nothing. Not even nothing.
      </div>
    </Html>
  );
}

## Approved Plan:
# Plan: Genesis TDD Fixes + A2UI/AG-UI Protocol Stack

## Context

The Genesis webapp (Next.js + React Three Fiber) is live on Tailscale Funnel but has 5 verified bugs. Strategically, Google's A2UI and AG-UI protocols present an opportunity: Cohezion already implements MCP + A2A, adding A2UI + AG-UI makes it one of the first full agent protocol stack implementations. The strategic work (declarative component catalog) also solves the immediate problem — making the Genesis experience agent-testable.

**Branch:** Must create worktree off `main` (currently on protected `challenge/nvidia-nemotron-reasoning`)
**Worktree:** `cz worktree create --json genesis-tdd-a2ui` → works in `.worktrees/spec-genesis-tdd-a2ui-*/`

---

## Phase 1: Fix 5 Genesis Bugs (TDD with Playwright MCP)

### 1.0 Setup worktree
- `git stash` if needed, then create worktree off main:
  ```bash
  cd /home/mike-anderson/dev/cohezion
  git worktree add .worktrees/genesis-tdd-a2ui main -b feat/genesis-tdd-a2ui
  cd .worktrees/genesis-tdd-a2ui
  ```
- Services already running via systemd: `cohezion-genesis.service` (port 3000), `cohezion-api.service` (port 8080)
- Verify with Playwright: `browser_navigate` to `http://localhost:3000/genesis`

### 1.1 Playwright smoke test baseline
Use Playwright MCP browser tools (not test files) to establish current state:
- Navigate to `http://localhost:3000/genesis`
- `browser_snapshot` to capture initial DOM state
- `browser_console_messages` to log JS errors (especially 404s)
- Click the void sphere, observe behavior

### 1.2 Fix: "CLICK TO BEGIN" overlaps VoidQuote
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** VoidSphere's "click to begin" `<Html>` at `position={[0, -1.2, 0]}` and VoidQuote at `position={[0, -1.5, 0]}` project to nearly the same screen Y.
**Fix:** Move VoidQuote position to `[0, 1.5, 0]` (above the sphere) or merge both into a single `<Html>` overlay below the sphere with proper stacking. Preferred: move quote above sphere (`y=1.2`), keep "click to begin" below (`y=-1.2`).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot shows both texts visible and non-overlapping.

### 1.3 Fix: Cosmogony sidebar visible during void
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** The `uiOpacity` gating (line 729-734) correctly returns 0 when `!hasInteracted`, but the equation panel and transition markers may still flash briefly or the container div itself may be visible. Need to verify live.
**Fix:** Ensure all sidebar elements have `display: none` (not just `opacity: 0`) when `uiOpacity === 0`, or wrap in conditional rendering `{uiOpacity > 0 && ...}` (which it already does — if still visible, it's a different element).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot before click shows no sidebar elements.

### 1.4 Fix: API 404 spam
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useCosmogony.ts` (line 115)
**Root cause:** `fetch(\`${API_BASE}/api/genesis/cosmogony/set-temperature\`, ...)` — this endpoint doesn't exist. Local Landau math already handles temperature computation.
**Fix:** Remove the fetch call entirely. The `computeLocalCosmogony()` in GenesisScene.tsx handles everything offline.
**Test:** `browser_console_messages` shows zero 404 errors after page load + interaction.

### 1.5 Fix: Sound too loud/harsh
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useSonification.ts`
**Root cause:** Master gain at 0.5, sawtooth waveform (line 180) is harsh, attacks too sharp.
**Fix:**
- Reduce master gain: `new Tone.Gain(0.15)` (was 0.5)
- Change sawtooth to triangle: `oscillator: { type: "triangle" }` (line 180)
- Soften all attacks: increase `attack` values by 2-3x across all envelopes
- Reduce noise volume: `-40` (was `-30`, line 154)
- Reduce fabric gain: `0.03` (was `0.06`, line 339), `0.02` (was `0.04`, line 353)
**Test:** Toggle sound on, no JS errors, no audio distortion at default volume.

### 1.6 Fix: Narration may not display
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useNarration.ts` + `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx`
**Root cause:** The overlay renders when `narration.currentText` is truthy (page.tsx line 229). If the API call fails or `narrateStage()` doesn't set `currentText`, overlay never appears.
**Fix:**
- Add console.log in `narrateStage` to trace state changes
- If API is unreachable, set `currentText` from the hardcoded narration map (already in useNarration.ts or from cosmogony narration strings)
- Ensure `currentText` is set immediately when `narrateStage` is called, not only after API response
**Test:** Playwright snapshot after clicking void shows narration text overlay.

---

## Phase 2: A2UI Component Catalog

### 2.1 Research A2UI spec
- Clone `https://github.com/google/A2UI.git` to `~/dev/A2UI`
- Study the 18 component primitives, JSON schema, and rendering pipeline
- Document which primitives map to Genesis components

### 2.2 Define component catalog
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/catalog.json`
Map existing React/R3F components to A2UI declarative format:
- `cohezion-void-sphere` → VoidSphere component
- `cohezion-explosion` → ExplosionParticles component
- `cohezion-bloch-sphere` → interactive 3D scene
- `cohezion-narration` → overlay text with TTS
- `cohezion-sound-engine` → Tone.js audio layer

### 2.3 Define experience script
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/experiences/genesis-cosmogony.json`
Declarative timeline replacing imperative phase logic in GenesisScene.tsx:
- Scenes: void → explosion → fabric-differentiation → settling → HIHO
- Each scene references catalog components with props
- Transitions defined as triggers (click, timer, temperature threshold)

### 2.4 Build A2UI renderer
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/A2UIRenderer.tsx`
Thin rendering layer that:
- Reads experience script JSON
- Instantiates React/R3F components from catalog
- Manages scene transitions
- Exposes component tree as inspectable JSON for agent testing

### 2.5 Refactor GenesisScene to use renderer
**Modified:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
Replace hardcoded phase logic with A2UI renderer consuming the experience script. Visual output should be identical — this is a refactor, not a redesign.

**Verification:** Side-by-side comparison using Playwright screenshots before/after refactor.

---

## Phase 3: AG-UI Event Streaming

### 3.1 Define AG-UI event types
**New file:** `src/cohezion/api/agui_events.py`
Map existing SSE events to AG-UI typed format:
- `TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT` → narration text
- `TOOL_CALL_START/RESULT` → phase transitions
- `STATE_DELTA` → universe ticks (coherence, temperature, CA)
- `RUN_FINISHED` → animation complete

### 3.2 AG-UI SSE endpoint
**New file:** `src/cohezion/api/routes/agui.py`
Replace `/api/universe/stream` with AG-UI-compatible SSE endpoint. Mount in FastAPI app.

### 3.3 Frontend AG-UI consumer
**Modified:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useUniverseStream.ts`
Replace custom SSE parsing with AG-UI typed event consumer. Route events to correct components.

**Verification:** SSE endpoint returns valid AG-UI events; frontend renders correctly from typed events.

---

## Phase 4: Documentation + Protocol Table

### 4.1 Update CLAUDE.md protocol table
Update the "What Cohezion Already Has" section with:
- A2UI: Strong — Genesis component catalog + declarative experience scripts
- AG-UI: Strong — Typed SSE events for all Genesis interactions

### 4.2 Update A2A agent card
Ensure `/.well-known/agent.json` reflects A2UI component catalog availability.

    10→function computeLocalCosmogony(temp: number): CosmogonyState {
    11→  const criticalTemps = [100, 10, 1.0, 0.1, 0.01];
    12→  const symmetries = ["void", "SO(12)", "SO(3)^4", "U(1)^4", "Z_2^4", "HIHO"];
    13→
    14→  let stageIdx = 0;
    15→  for (let i = 0; i < criticalTemps.length; i++) {
    16→    if (temp < criticalTemps[i]) stageIdx = i + 1;
    17→  }
    18→  const sym = symmetries[stageIdx];
    19→  const stage = stageIdx - 1;
    20→
    21→  const a = 1.0;
    22→  const b = 0.5;
    23→  const criticalTemp = criticalTemps[Math.max(0, stageIdx - 1)] ?? 100;
    24→  const orderParameter =
    25→    temp < criticalTemp
    26→      ? Math.sqrt(a * (criticalTemp - temp) / (2 * b))
    27→      : 0;
    28→  const landauFreeEnergy =
    29→    orderParameter > 0
    30→      ? a * (temp - criticalTemp) * orderParameter ** 2 + b * orderParameter ** 4
    31→      : 0;
    32→
    33→  const closestTc = criticalTemps.reduce((closest, tc) =>
    34→    Math.abs(tc - temp) < Math.abs(closest - temp) ? tc : closest
    35→  );
    36→  const fisherEig = closestTc > 0 ? 1 / (Math.abs(temp - closestTc) + 0.01) : 0;
    37→
    38→  const transitionNames = ["SO(12)", "SO(3)^4", "U(1)^4", "Z_2^4", "HIHO"];
    39→  const transitions = criticalTemps
    40→    .filter((tc) => temp < tc)
    41→    .map((tc, i) => ({
    42→      from: i === 0 ? "void" : transitionNames[i - 1],
    43→      to: transitionNames[i],
    44→      T_critical: tc,
    45→      stage: i,
    46→    }));
    47→
    48→  return {
    49→    temperature: temp,
    50→    symmetry: sym,
    51→    stage,
    52→    order_parameters: { fabric_differentiation: orderParameter },
    53→    transitions,
    54→    fisher_eigenvalue_max: fisherEig,
    55→    landau_free_energy: landauFreeEnergy,
    56→  };
    57→}

     1→"use client";
     2→
     3→import { useRef, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
     4→import * as Tone from "tone";
     5→
     6→/**
     7→ * Physics-to-audio mapping for the Genesis Engine.
     8→ *
     9→ * Each physics quantity maps to a specific audio parameter:
    10→ * - Coherence -> pitch (HIHO=C4, deviation=detuning)
    11→ * - Entropy -> texture (low=pure sine, high=noise)
    12→ * - Temperature -> amplitude (hot=loud, cold=quiet)
    13→ * - SPIN rotation -> stereo pan (left/right)
    14→ * - SPIN precession -> tremolo rate
    15→ * - Gauge curvature -> reverb depth
    16→ * - Phase transitions -> percussion impacts
    17→ *
    18→ * Cinematic additions (Part 5):
    19→ * - Void drone: quiet sine wave at C2 (-40dB)
    20→ * - Explosion impact: MembraneSynth hit + rising sweep C2->C4
    21→ * - Fabric chord: Em7 spread (E3, G3, B3, D4) from unison
    22→ * - Settling pad: warm sustained chord resolving to final state
    23→ *
    24→ * Inspired by:
    25→ * - Brian Eno, "Music for Airports" (void drone)
    26→ * - Steve Reich, "Music for 18 Musicians" (phasing/precession)
    27→ * - Ligeti, "Atmospheres" (symmetry breaking)
    28→ * - Ryoji Ikeda, "datamatics" (data sonification)
    29→ */
    30→
    31→export interface PhysicsState {
    32→  coherence: number; // [0, 1]
    33→  entropy: number; // [0, inf) typically [0, 3]
    34→  temperature: number; // [0, 200]
    35→  spinRotation: number; // [-1, 1] <sigma_x>
    36→  spinPrecession: number; // [-1, 1] <sigma_y>
    37→  chargPolarity: number; // [-1, 1] <sigma_z>
    38→  gaugeCurvature: number; // [0, inf) Yang-Mills action
    39→  symmetry: string; // current symmetry group
    40→}
    41→
    42→interface SonificationControls {
    43→  /** Whether audio is currently playing */
    44→  playing: boolean;
    45→  /** Master volume [0, 1] */
    46→  volume: number;
    47→  /** Start the sonification engine */
    48→  start: () => Promise<void>;
    49→  /** Stop all audio */
    50→  stop: () => void;
    51→  /** Update physics state -> audio parameters */
    52→  update: (state: PhysicsState) => void;
    53→  /** Set master volume */
    54→  setVolume: (v: number) => void;
    55→  /** Trigger a phase transition impact sound */
    56→  triggerTransition: (fromSym: string, toSym: string) => void;
    57→  /** Start the void drone (quiet C2 sine, -40dB) */
    58→  startVoidDrone: () => Promise<void>;
    59→  /** Stop the void drone */
    60→  stopVoidDrone: () => void;
    61→  /** Trigger the explosion impact + rising sweep */
    62→  triggerExplosion: () => void;
    63→  /** Start 4 fabric oscillators spreading from unison to Em7 */
    64→  startFabricChord: () => void;
    65→  /** Resolve to warm sustained pad */
    66→  settleToSustainedPad: () => void;
    67→}
    68→
    69→// Map coherence [0,1] to MIDI note. HIHO (0.5) = C4 (60)
    70→function coherenceToFreq(coherence: number): number {
    71→  // C4 = 261.63 Hz at HIHO (0.5)
    72→  // Detuning: +/-1 octave for full range
    73→  const semitones = (coherence - 0.5) * 24; // +/-12 semitones
    74→  return 261.63 * Math.pow(2, semitones / 12);
    75→}
    76→
    77→// Map entropy to noise mix [0, 1]
    78→function entropyToNoiseMix(entropy: number): number {
    79→  return Math.min(entropy / 3.0, 1.0);
    80→}
    81→
    82→// Map temperature to amplitude [0, 0.3]
    83→function temperatureToAmplitude(temperature: number): number {
    84→  // Hot = louder, cold = quieter (but never silent)
    85→  const normalized = Math.min(temperature / 100, 1.0);
    86→  return 0.02 + normalized * 0.15;
    87→}
    88→
    89→// Note name to frequency
    90→function noteToFreq(note: string): number {
    91→  const map: Record<string, number> = {
    92→    C1: 32.7,
    93→    C2: 65.41,
    94→    E3: 164.81,
    95→    G3: 196.0,
    96→    B3: 246.94,
    97→    D4: 293.66,
    98→    C4: 261.63,
    99→  };
   100→  return map[note] ?? 261.63;
   101→}
   102→
   103→export function useSonification(): SonificationControls {
   104→  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
   105→  const [volume, setVolumeState] = useState(0.5);
   106→
   107→  // Audio nodes (refs to persist across renders)
   108→  const synthRef = useRef<Tone.Synth | null>(null);
   109→  const noiseRef = useRef<Tone.Noise | null>(null);
   110→  const pannerRef = useRef<Tone.Panner | null>(null);
   111→  const reverbRef = useRef<Tone.Reverb | null>(null);
   112→  const gainRef = useRef<Tone.Gain | null>(null);
   113→  const tremoloRef = useRef<Tone.Tremolo | null>(null);
   114→  const impactSynthRef = useRef<Tone.MembraneSynth | null>(null);
   115→  const initializedRef = useRef(false);
   116→
   117→  // Cinematic audio nodes
   118→  const voidDroneRef = useRef<Tone.Synth | null>(null);
   119→  const voidDroneGainRef = useRef<Tone.Gain | null>(null);
   120→  const sweepSynthRef = useRef<Tone.Synth | null>(null);
   121→  const fabricSynthsRef = useRef<Tone.Synth[]>([]);
   122→  const fabricGainRef = useRef<Tone.Gain | null>(null);
   123→
   124→  // Initialize audio graph
   125→  const initAudio = useCallback(() => {
   126→    if (initializedRef.current) return;
   127→
   128→    // Master gain
   129→    const gain = new Tone.Gain(0.5).toDestination();
   130→    gainRef.current = gain;
   131→
   132→    // Reverb (gauge curvature -> depth)
   133→    const reverb = new Tone.Reverb({ decay: 2, wet: 0.1 }).connect(gain);
   134→    reverbRef.current = reverb;
   135→
   136→    // Panner (SPIN rotation -> stereo)
   137→    const panner = new Tone.Panner(0).connect(reverb);
   138→    pannerRef.current = panner;
   139→
   140→    // Tremolo (SPIN precession -> rate)
   141→    const tremolo = new Tone.Tremolo({ frequency: 2, depth: 0.3 })
   142→      .connect(panner)
   143→      .start();
   144→    tremoloRef.current = tremolo;
   145→
   146→    // Main synth (coherence -> pitch, continuous tone)
   147→    const synth = new Tone.Synth({
   148→      oscillator: { type: "sine" },
   149→      envelope: { attack: 0.5, decay: 0.2, sustain: 0.8, release: 1.0 },
   150→    }).connect(tremolo);
   151→    synthRef.current = synth;
   152→
   153→    // Noise (entropy -> texture)
   154→    const noise = new Tone.Noise({ type: "pink", volume: -30 }).connect(
   155→      panner
   156→    );
   157→    noiseRef.current = noise;
   158→
   159→    // Impact synth for phase transitions
   160→    const impact = new Tone.MembraneSynth({
   161→      pitchDecay: 0.05,
   162→      octaves: 6,
   163→      envelope: { attack: 0.001, decay: 0.4, sustain: 0, release: 0.4 },
   164→    }).connect(gain);
   165→    impactSynthRef.current = impact;
   166→
   167→    // --- Cinematic nodes ---
   168→
   169→    // Void drone: very quiet sine at C2
   170→    const voidDroneGain = new Tone.Gain(0).connect(gain);
   171→    voidDroneGainRef.current = voidDroneGain;
   172→    const voidDrone = new Tone.Synth({
   173→      oscillator: { type: "sine" },
   174→      envelope: { attack: 2.0, decay: 0.5, sustain: 1.0, release: 3.0 },
   175→    }).connect(voidDroneGain);
   176→    voidDroneRef.current = voidDrone;
   177→
   178→    // Sweep synth for explosion rising glissando
   179→    const sweep = new Tone.Synth({
   180→      oscillator: { type: "sawtooth" },
   181→      envelope: { attack: 0.01, decay: 0.1, sustain: 0.8, release: 1.0 },
   182→    }).connect(gain);
   183→    sweepSynthRef.current = sweep;
   184→
   185→    // Fabric chord: 4 oscillators, one per fabric
   186→    const fabricGain = new Tone.Gain(0).connect(gain);
   187→    fabricGainRef.current = fabricGain;
   188→    const fabricSynths: Tone.Synth[] = [];
   189→    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   190→      const s = new Tone.Synth({
   191→        oscillator: { type: "triangle" },
   192→        envelope: { attack: 1.0, decay: 0.3, sustain: 0.9, release: 2.0 },
   193→      }).connect(fabricGain);
   194→      fabricSynths.push(s);
   195→    }
   196→    fabricSynthsRef.current = fabricSynths;
   197→
   198→    initializedRef.current = true;
   199→  }, []);
   200→
   201→  const start = useCallback(async () => {
   202→    await Tone.start(); // Required: user gesture to start AudioContext
   203→    initAudio();
   204→
   205→    if (synthRef.current && !playing) {
   206→      synthRef.current.triggerAttack(261.63); // Start at C4 (HIHO)
   207→      noiseRef.current?.start();
   208→      setPlaying(true);
   209→    }
   210→  }, [initAudio, playing]);
   211→
   212→  const stop = useCallback(() => {
   213→    synthRef.current?.triggerRelease();
   214→    noiseRef.current?.stop();
   215→    voidDroneRef.current?.triggerRelease();
   216→    sweepSynthRef.current?.triggerRelease();
   217→    fabricSynthsRef.current.forEach((s) => s.triggerRelease());
   218→    setPlaying(false);
   219→  }, []);
   220→
   221→  const update = useCallback(
   222→    (state: PhysicsState) => {
   223→      if (!playing || !synthRef.current) return;
   224→
   225→      // Coherence -> pitch
   226→      const freq = coherenceToFreq(state.coherence);
   227→      synthRef.current.frequency.rampTo(freq, 0.1);
   228→
   229→      // Entropy -> noise level
   230→      const noiseMix = entropyToNoiseMix(state.entropy);
   231→      if (noiseRef.current) {
   232→        noiseRef.current.volume.rampTo(-30 + noiseMix * 20, 0.1);
   233→      }
   234→
   235→      // Temperature -> amplitude
   236→      const amp = temperatureToAmplitude(state.temperature);
   237→      if (gainRef.current) {
   238→        gainRef.current.gain.rampTo(amp * volume, 0.1);
   239→      }
   240→
   241→      // SPIN rotation -> stereo pan [-1, 1]
   242→      if (pannerRef.current) {
   243→        pannerRef.current.pan.rampTo(state.spinRotation, 0.1);
   244→      }
   245→
   246→      // SPIN precession -> tremolo rate [0.5, 10]
   247→      if (tremoloRef.current) {
   248→        const rate = 0.5 + Math.abs(state.spinPrecession) * 9.5;
   249→        tremoloRef.current.frequency.rampTo(rate, 0.1);
   250→      }
   251→
   252→      // Gauge curvature -> reverb wet [0, 0.8]
   253→      if (reverbRef.current) {
   254→        const wet = Math.min(state.gaugeCurvature * 0.2, 0.8);
   255→        reverbRef.current.wet.rampTo(wet, 0.3);
   256→      }
   257→    },
   258→    [playing, volume]
   259→  );
   260→
   261→  const setVolume = useCallback((v: number) => {
   262→    setVolumeState(v);
   263→    if (gainRef.current) {
   264→      gainRef.current.gain.rampTo(v * 0.3, 0.1);
   265→    }
   266→  }, []);
   267→
   268→  const triggerTransition = useCallback(
   269→    (fromSym: string, toSym: string) => {
   270→      if (!impactSynthRef.current) {
   271→        initAudio();
   272→      }
   273→
   274→      // Different impact sounds per transition stage
   275→      const pitchMap: Record<string, string> = {
   276→        "SO(12)": "C2",
   277→        "SO(3)^4": "E2",
   278→        "U(1)^4": "G2",
   279→        "Z_2^4": "B2",
   280→        HIHO: "C3",
   281→      };
   282→
   283→      const note = pitchMap[toSym] ?? "C2";
   284→      impactSynthRef.current?.triggerAttackRelease(note, "8n");
   285→    },
   286→    [initAudio]
   287→  );
   288→
   289→  // --- Cinematic: Void drone ---
   290→  const startVoidDrone = useCallback(async () => {
   291→    await Tone.start();
   292→    initAudio();
   293→
   294→    if (voidDroneRef.current && voidDroneGainRef.current) {
   295→      // -40dB is ~ 0.01 gain
   296→      voidDroneGainRef.current.gain.rampTo(0.01, 0.5);
   297→      voidDroneRef.current.triggerAttack(noteToFreq("C2"));
   298→    }
   299→  }, [initAudio]);
   300→
   301→  const stopVoidDrone = useCallback(() => {
   302→    if (voidDroneRef.current) {
   303→      voidDroneRef.current.triggerRelease();
   304→    }
   305→    if (voidDroneGainRef.current) {
   306→      voidDroneGainRef.current.gain.rampTo(0, 2.0);
   307→    }
   308→  }, []);
   309→
   310→  // --- Cinematic: Explosion impact + rising sweep ---
   311→  const triggerExplosion = useCallback(() => {
   312→    initAudio();
   313→
   314→    // Impact hit: C1 on MembraneSynth
   315→    impactSynthRef.current?.triggerAttackRelease("C1", "4n");
   316→
   317→    // Rising sweep: C2 -> C4 over 2 seconds
   318→    if (sweepSynthRef.current) {
   319→      sweepSynthRef.current.triggerAttack(noteToFreq("C2"));
   320→      sweepSynthRef.current.frequency.rampTo(noteToFreq("C4"), 2.0);
   321→      // Release after the sweep
   322→      setTimeout(() => {
   323→        sweepSynthRef.current?.triggerRelease();
   324→      }, 2200);
   325→    }
   326→
   327→    // Fade out void drone
   328→    stopVoidDrone();
   329→  }, [initAudio, stopVoidDrone]);
   330→
   331→  // --- Cinematic: Fabric chord (Em7: E3, G3, B3, D4) ---
   332→  const startFabricChord = useCallback(() => {
   333→    initAudio();
   334→
   335→    const targetNotes = ["E3", "G3", "B3", "D4"];
   336→    const startFreq = noteToFreq("E3"); // All start at unison E3
   337→
   338→    if (fabricGainRef.current) {
   339→      fabricGainRef.current.gain.rampTo(0.06, 1.0);
   340→    }
   341→
   342→    fabricSynthsRef.current.forEach((synth, i) => {
   343→      // Start all at unison, then spread over 2 seconds
   344→      synth.triggerAttack(startFreq);
   345→      synth.frequency.rampTo(noteToFreq(targetNotes[i]), 2.0);
   346→    });
   347→  }, [initAudio]);
   348→
   349→  // --- Cinematic: Settle to sustained pad ---
   350→  const settleToSustainedPad = useCallback(() => {
   351→    // Fabric chord is already playing; just lower volume and add warmth
   352→    if (fabricGainRef.current) {
   353→      fabricGainRef.current.gain.rampTo(0.04, 3.0);
   354→    }
   355→
   356→    // If tremolo is active, sync to gentle rate (HIHO coherence)
   357→    if (tremoloRef.current) {
   358→      tremoloRef.current.frequency.rampTo(1.5, 2.0);
   359→      tremoloRef.current.depth.rampTo(0.15, 2.0);
   360→    }
   361→
   362→    // Increase reverb for warmth
   363→    if (reverbRef.current) {
   364→      reverbRef.current.wet.rampTo(0.4, 3.0);
   365→    }
   366→  }, []);
   367→
   368→  // Cleanup on unmount
   369→  useEffect(() => {
   370→    return () => {
   371→      synthRef.current?.dispose();
   372→      noiseRef.current?.dispose();
   373→      pannerRef.current?.dispose();
   374→      reverbRef.current?.dispose();
   375→      gainRef.current?.dispose();
   376→      tremoloRef.current?.dispose();
   377→      impactSynthRef.current?.dispose();
   378→      voidDroneRef.current?.dispose();
   379→      voidDroneGainRef.current?.dispose();
   380→      sweepSynthRef.current?.dispose();
   381→      fabricSynthsRef.current.forEach((s) => s.dispose());
   382→      fabricGainRef.current?.dispose();
   383→    };
   384→  }, []);
   385→
   386→  return {
   387→    playing,
   388→    volume,
   389→    start,
   390→    stop,
   391→    update,
   392→    setVolume,
   393→    triggerTransition,
   394→    startVoidDrone,
   395→    stopVoidDrone,
   396→    triggerExplosion,
   397→    startFabricChord,
   398→    settleToSustainedPad,
   399→  };
   400→}

```
     1→#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2→# PreToolUse: Edit|Write
     3→# Blocks edits on protected branches unless in an active worktree.
     4→# Uses PreToolUse JSON protocol: {"decision": "block"} to prevent edits.
     5→
     6→# Read stdin (hook JSON payload) to check file path
     7→HOOK_INPUT=$(cat)
     8→
     9→# Extract file_path from hook input (Edit or Write tool)
    10→FILE_PATH=$(echo "$HOOK_INPUT" | python3 -c "
    11→import sys, json
    12→try:
    13→    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    14→    print(data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', ''))
    15→except Exception:
    16→    print('')
    17→" 2>/dev/null)
    18→
    19→# If file is outside the git repo root, always allow
    20→if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ]; then
    21→    REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)
    22→    if [ -n "$REPO_ROOT" ]; then
    23→        # Resolve to absolute path for comparison
    24→        ABS_FILE=$(python3 -c "import os; print(os.path.abspath('$FILE_PATH'))" 2>/dev/null)
    25→        case "$ABS_FILE" in
    26→            "$REPO_ROOT"/*) ;; # Inside repo, continue checks
    27→            *) exit 0 ;;       # Outside repo, allow unconditionally
    28→        esac
    29→    fi
    30→fi
    31→
    32→PROTECTED_PATTERNS=("main" "develop" "challenge/*" "release/*")
    33→
    34→branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    35→worktree_active=$(cz worktree status --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('active', False))" 2>/dev/null)
    36→
    37→# If in an active worktree, always allow (worktree IS the isolation)
    38→if [ "$worktree_active" = "True" ]; then
    39→    exit 0
    40→fi
    41→
    42→# Check if branch matches any protected pattern
    43→is_protected=false
    44→for pattern in "${PROTECTED_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
    45→    case "$branch" in
    46→        $pattern) is_protected=true; break ;;
    47→    esac
    48→done
    49→
    50→if [ "$is_protected" = true ]; then
    51→    echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: Editing on protected branch '"'$branch'"'. Create a worktree first: cz worktree create --json <slug>"}'
    52→    exit 0
    53→fi
    54→
    55→exit 0
    56→

Confirmed — the error is in `startVoidDrone` trying to call `triggerAttack` on a synth that hasn't properly started yet (the AudioContext wasn't ready). The fix: add a small delay after `Tone.start()` before triggering the drone:

> TOOL

tool_use Bash
id: toolu_01DLzSytAe3wcNxVb3BdPJso
```json
{
  "command": "python3 << 'PYEOF'\nf = \"/home/mike-anderson/dev/cohezion/.worktrees/genesis-tdd-a2ui/src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useSonification.ts\"\nwith open(f, \"r\") as fh:\n    content = fh.read()\n\n# The issue: triggerAttack is called immediately after Tone.start(),\n# but the AudioContext may not be running yet (browser policy).\n# Fix: wrap in try/catch and add a small scheduling delay\nold = '''  const startVoidDrone = useCallback(async () => {\n    await Tone.start();\n    initAudio();\n\n    if (voidDroneRef.current && voidDroneGainRef.current) {\n      // -40dB is ~ 0.01 gain\n      voidDroneGainRef.current.gain.rampTo(0.01, 0.5);\n      voidDroneRef.current.triggerAttack(noteToFreq(\"C2\"));\n    }\n  }, [initAudio]);'''\n\nnew = '''  const startVoidDrone = useCallback(async () => {\n    try {\n      await Tone.start();\n      initAudio();\n\n      if (voidDroneRef.current && voidDroneGainRef.current) {\n        // -40dB is ~ 0.01 gain\n        voidDroneGainRef.current.gain.rampTo(0.01, 0.5);\n        // Schedule slightly in the future to avoid \"start time\" race\n        const now = Tone.now();\n        voidDroneRef.current.triggerAttack(noteToFreq(\"C2\"), now + 0.1);\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // AudioContext not ready yet (no user gesture) — silently skip\n    }\n  }, [initAudio]);'''\n\nif old in content:\n    content = content.replace(old, new)\n    with open(f, \"w\") as fh:\n        fh.write(content)\n    print(\"Fixed startVoidDrone — scheduled with delay + try/catch\")\nelse:\n    print(\"ERROR: old string not found\")\nPYEOF",
  "description": "Fix Tone.js start time error in void drone"
}

#!/bin/bash

# Ralph Loop Setup Script
# Creates state file for in-session Ralph loop

set -euo pipefail

# Parse arguments
PROMPT_PARTS=()
MAX_ITERATIONS=0
COMPLETION_PROMISE="null"

# Parse options and positional arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case $1 in
    -h|--help)
      cat << 'HELP_EOF'
Ralph Loop - Interactive self-referential development loop

USAGE:
  /ralph-loop [PROMPT...] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
  PROMPT...    Initial prompt to start the loop (can be multiple words without quotes)

OPTIONS:
  --max-iterations <n>           Maximum iterations before auto-stop (default: unlimited)
  --completion-promise '<text>'  Promise phrase (USE QUOTES for multi-word)
  -h, --help                     Show this help message

DESCRIPTION:
  Starts a Ralph Loop in your CURRENT session. The stop hook prevents
  exit and feeds your output back as input until completion or iteration limit.

  To signal completion, you must output: <promise>YOUR_PHRASE</promise>

  Use this for:
  - Interactive iteration where you want to see progress
  - Tasks requiring self-correction and refinement
  - Learning how Ralph works

EXAMPLES:
  /ralph-loop Build a todo API --completion-promise 'DONE' --max-iterations 20
  /ralph-loop --max-iterations 10 Fix the auth bug
  /ralph-loop Refactor cache layer  (runs forever)
  /ralph-loop --completion-promise 'TASK COMPLETE' Create a REST API

STOPPING:
  Only by reaching --max-iterations or detecting --completion-promise
  No manual stop - Ralph runs infinitely by default!

MONITORING:
  # View current iteration:
  grep '^iteration:' .claude/ralph-loop.local.md

  # View full state:
  head -10 .claude/ralph-loop.local.md
HELP_EOF
      exit 0
      ;;
    --max-iterations)
      if [[ -z "${2:-}" ]]; then
        echo "❌ Error: --max-iterations requires a number argument" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   Valid examples:" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 10" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 50" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 0  (unlimited)" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   You provided: --max-iterations (with no number)" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      if ! [[ "$2" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        echo "❌ Error: --max-iterations must be a positive integer or 0, got: $2" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   Valid examples:" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 10" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 50" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 0  (unlimited)" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   Invalid: decimals (10.5), negative numbers (-5), text" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      MAX_ITERATIONS="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --completion-promise)
      if [[ -z "${2:-}" ]]; then
        echo "❌ Error: --completion-promise requires a text argument" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   Valid examples:" >&2
        echo "     --completion-promise 'DONE'" >&2
        echo "     --completion-promise 'TASK COMPLETE'" >&2
        echo "     --completion-promise 'All tests passing'" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   You provided: --completion-promise (with no text)" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   Note: Multi-word promises must be quoted!" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      COMPLETION_PROMISE="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *)
      # Non-option argument - collect all as prompt parts
      PROMPT_PARTS+=("$1")
      shift
      ;;
  esac
done

# Join all prompt parts with spaces
PROMPT="${PROMPT_PARTS[*]:-}"

# Validate prompt is non-empty
if [[ -z "$PROMPT" ]]; then
  echo "❌ Error: No prompt provided" >&2
  echo "" >&2
  echo "   Ralph needs a task description to work on." >&2
  echo "" >&2
  echo "   Examples:" >&2
  echo "     /ralph-loop Build a REST API for todos" >&2
  echo "     /ralph-loop Fix the auth bug --max-iterations 20" >&2
  echo "     /ralph-loop --completion-promise 'DONE' Refactor code" >&2
  echo "" >&2
  echo "   For all options: /ralph-loop --help" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Create state file for stop hook (markdown with YAML frontmatter)
mkdir -p .claude

# Quote completion promise for YAML if it contains special chars or is not null
if [[ -n "$COMPLETION_PROMISE" ]] && [[ "$COMPLETION_PROMISE" != "null" ]]; then
  COMPLETION_PROMISE_YAML="\"$COMPLETION_PROMISE\""
else
  COMPLETION_PROMISE_YAML="null"
fi

cat > .claude/ralph-loop.local.md <<EOF
---
active: true
iteration: 1
session_id: ${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}
max_iterations: $MAX_ITERATIONS
completion_promise: $COMPLETION_PROMISE_YAML
started_at: "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
---

$PROMPT
EOF

# Output setup message
cat <<EOF
🔄 Ralph loop activated in this session!

Iteration: 1
Max iterations: $(if [[ $MAX_ITERATIONS -gt 0 ]]; then echo $MAX_ITERATIONS; else echo "unlimited"; fi)
Completion promise: $(if [[ "$COMPLETION_PROMISE" != "null" ]]; then echo "${COMPLETION_PROMISE//\"/} (ONLY output when TRUE - do not lie!)"; else echo "none (runs forever)"; fi)

The stop hook is now active. When you try to exit, the SAME PROMPT will be
fed back to you. You'll see your previous work in files, creating a
self-referential loop where you iteratively improve on the same task.

To monitor: head -10 .claude/ralph-loop.local.md

⚠️  WARNING: This loop cannot be stopped manually! It will run infinitely
    unless you set --max-iterations or --completion-promise.

🔄
EOF

# Output the initial prompt if provided
if [[ -n "$PROMPT" ]]; then
  echo ""
  echo "$PROMPT"
fi

# Display completion promise requirements if set
if [[ "$COMPLETION_PROMISE" != "null" ]]; then
  echo ""
  echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
  echo "CRITICAL - Ralph Loop Completion Promise"
  echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
  echo ""
  echo "To complete this loop, output this EXACT text:"
  echo "  <promise>$COMPLETION_PROMISE</promise>"
  echo ""
  echo "STRICT REQUIREMENTS (DO NOT VIOLATE):"
  echo "  ✓ Use <promise> XML tags EXACTLY as shown above"
  echo "  ✓ The statement MUST be completely and unequivocally TRUE"
  echo "  ✓ Do NOT output false statements to exit the loop"

Here's a comprehensive overview of **Google's A2UI (Agent-to-User Interface) Protocol**:

## What is A2UI?

A2UI is a streaming protocol for Agent-Driven User Interfaces. It is an open-source project, complete with a format optimized for representing updatable agent-generated UIs and an initial set of renderers, that allows agents to generate or populate rich user interfaces.

Google made the A2UI project public on December 15, 2025, and it was designed to address the specific challenges of interoperable, cross-platform, generative or template-based UI responses from agents.

## How It Works

An agent does not output HTML or JavaScript. It outputs an A2UI response, which is a JSON payload that describes a set of components, their properties and a data model. The client application reads this description and maps each component to its own native widgets, for example Angular components, Flutter widgets, web components, React components or SwiftUI views.

The pipeline has four stages:

1. **Generation:** An Agent (using Gemini or another LLM) generates or uses a pre-generated A2UI Response, a JSON payload describing the composition of UI components and their properties.
2. **Transport:** This message is sent to the client application (via A2A, AG UI, etc.).
3. **Resolution:** The Client's A2UI Renderer parses the JSON.
4. **Rendering:** The Renderer maps the abstract components (e.g., type: 'text-field') to the concrete implementation in the client's codebase.

## Key Design Principles

- **Security First:** Running arbitrary code generated by an LLM may present a security risk. A2UI is a declarative data format, not executable code. Your client application maintains a "catalog" of trusted, pre-approved UI components (e.g., Card, Button, TextField), and the agent can only request to render components from that catalog.

- **LLM-Friendly:** The UI is represented as a flat list of components with ID references which is easy for LLMs to generate incrementally, allowing for progressive rendering and a responsive user experience. An agent can efficiently make incremental changes to the UI based on new user requests as the conversation progresses.

- **Framework-Agnostic:** A2UI separates the UI structure from the UI implementation. The agent sends a description of the component tree and its associated data model. Your client application is responsible for mapping these abstract descriptions to its native widgets. The same A2UI JSON payload from an agent can be rendered on multiple different clients built on top of different frameworks.

## Current Status

A2UI is currently in v0.8 (Public Preview). The specification and implementations are functional but are still evolving. They are opening the project to foster collaboration, gather feedback, and solicit contributions. Expect changes.

## Ecosystem & Licensing

A2UI is an Apache 2 licensed project. A2UI is not intended to replace existing agent frameworks but to serve as a specialized protocol for interoperable, generative UI responses. It fits into a broader ecosystem of agent communication standards. The Agent-User Interaction Protocol (AG-UI), developed by CopilotKit, is often discussed alongside A2UI. They are complementary layers, not competing technologies.

## Competitive Landscape

For UI at least, there are now two fairly clear approaches: Build a mini web app (favored by OpenAI and Anthropic, and now supported by MCP Apps) or take a "native-first" approach with Google's A2UI.

## Key Resources

- **Official site:** [a2ui.org](https://a2ui.org/)
- **GitHub repo:** [github.com/google/A2UI](https://github.com/google/A2UI/)
- **Google Developers Blog:** [Introducing A2UI](https://developers.googleblog.com/introducing-a2ui-an-open-project-for-agent-driven-interfaces/)

Here's a comprehensive overview of the **AG-UI (Agent-User Interaction) Protocol** and its relationship with Google's **A2UI** specification and **CopilotKit**:

---

## AG-UI Protocol Overview

AG-UI (Agent–User Interaction) is a general-purpose, bi-directional connection between a user-facing application and any agentic backend. It is the connective layer that transforms agents from background processes into true collaborators — transparent, reliable, and always aligned with the user.

AG-UI was born from CopilotKit's initial partnership with LangGraph and CrewAI — and brings the incredibly popular agent-user-interactivity infrastructure to the wider agentic ecosystem.

### Key Capabilities

- **Shared State:** Bi-directional synchronization of agent and application state — either read/write or read-only.
- AG‑UI is an open, event-based protocol that standardizes the live stream between agent and app: messages, tool calls, state updates, and UI surface events.
- You can build integrations for new agent frameworks, custom in-house solutions, or use AG-UI without any agent framework. You can also build new clients for AG-UI-compatible agents (web, mobile, Slack, messaging, etc.).

---

## AG-UI vs. A2UI (Google) — Complementary, Not Competing

While MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) handle context and agent coordination, AG-UI defines the layer of interaction between the user, the application, and the agent.

A2UI is a generative UI specification (from Google) — which agents can use to deliver UI widgets, where AG-UI provides the complete bi-directional runtime connection between any agentic backend and a user-facing application.

A2UI is Apache 2.0 licensed, created by Google with contributions from CopilotKit and the open source community, and is in active development on GitHub. The problem A2UI solves is: how can AI agents safely send rich UIs across trust boundaries? Instead of text-only responses or risky code execution, A2UI lets agents send declarative component descriptions that clients render using their own native widgets.

In short: Agent Spec defines what runs, AG‑UI carries the interaction, and A2UI defines what the user touches.

---

## Google ADK + AG-UI Integration

Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) now works with AG-UI, an open protocol for building rich, interactive AI user experiences. By combining a powerful backend (ADK) with a flexible frontend protocol (AG-UI), you can build truly interactive AI applications. ADK runs the agent's "brain" and tool orchestration, while AG-UI provides a communication channel to UI components for a seamless user experience.

---

## CopilotKit Implementation

CopilotKit provides first-class support for the AG-UI protocol across its entire stack, using it as the foundation for agent-to-UI communication.

The CopilotKit runtime (`@copilotkit/runtime`) consumes AG-UI messages from agents and translates them into GraphQL events that stream to the frontend. CopilotKit's React SDK provides hooks like `useAgent` and `useCoAgent` for consuming AG-UI streams.

Framework flexibility is supported with AG-UI clients available for React, Angular, Vue, etc. Standard inspector tools exist for AG-UI message streams, and agents and UIs from different vendors can work together through the protocol's interoperability.

---

## Industry Collaboration (Oracle, Google, CopilotKit)

Oracle, CopilotKit, and Google are aligning three open specifications so agentic apps can be assembled end-to-end with portable parts: Open Agent Specification (from Oracle), AG‑UI (from CopilotKit), and A2UI (from Google). The goal is to swap implementations at any layer while keeping the experience stable.

---

### Key Resources
- **AG-UI Docs:** [docs.ag-ui.com](https://docs.ag-ui.com/)
- **GitHub:** [github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui](https://github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui)
- **A2UI Spec:** [a2ui.org](https://a2ui.org/)
- **CopilotKit AG-UI Docs:** [docs.copilotkit.ai/learn/ag-ui-protocol](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/learn/ag-ui-protocol)

# A2UI Specification Summary

Based on the provided documentation, here's what I can extract about A2UI's structure:

## Core Definition
"A2UI (Agent to UI) is a declarative UI protocol for agent-driven interfaces. AI agents generate rich, interactive UIs that render natively across platforms (web, mobile, desktop) without executing arbitrary code."

## Message Structure

The protocol uses JSON messages with these key types:
- `surfaceUpdate` / `updateComponents` (v0.9)
- `dataModelUpdate`
- `beginRendering` / `createSurface` (v0.9)

## Component Format (v0.8)
Components use nested objects:
```json
{
  "id": "component-id",
  "component": {
    "ComponentType": {
      "property": "value"
    }
  }
}
```

## Component Format (v0.9 - Simplified)
```json
{
  "id": "component-id",
  "component": "Text",
  "text": "Content",
  "variant": "h1"
}
```

## Key Architectural Elements

**Surface**: "Canvas for components (dialog, sidebar, main view)"

**Catalog**: Referenced by ID (e.g., `"https://a2ui.org/specification/v0_9/basic_catalog.json"`), defines available component types

**Data Model**: State structure with path-based references like `{"path": "/booking/date"}`

**Actions**: Components trigger events with `"action": {"event": {"name": "event_name"}}`

## Important Limitation
The documentation provided is introductory only. For complete JSON schema, full catalog definitions, and comprehensive component type specifications, you'll need to review the [formal specification documents](../../specification/) linked in the navigation.

# AG-UI Event Types Reference

Based on the documentation provided, here are the core event types with their field structures:

## Lifecycle Events

**RUN_STARTED**
- `type`: "RUN_STARTED"
- `threadId`: string
- `runId`: string
- `parentRunId`: string (optional)
- `input`: object (optional)
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**RUN_FINISHED**
- `type`: "RUN_FINISHED"
- `threadId`: string
- `runId`: string
- `result`: any (optional)
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**RUN_ERROR**
- `type`: "RUN_ERROR"
- `message`: string
- `code`: string (optional)
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**STEP_STARTED** / **STEP_FINISHED**
- `stepName`: string

## Text Message Events

**TEXT_MESSAGE_START**
- `type`: "TEXT_MESSAGE_START"
- `messageId`: string
- `role`: string ("developer", "system", "assistant", "user", "tool")
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT**
- `type`: "TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT"
- `messageId`: string
- `delta`: string (non-empty)
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**TEXT_MESSAGE_END**
- `type`: "TEXT_MESSAGE_END"
- `messageId`: string
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK** (convenience event)
- `messageId`: string (required on first chunk)
- `role`: string (optional, defaults to "assistant")
- `delta`: string (optional)

## Tool Call Events

**TOOL_CALL_START**
- `type`: "TOOL_CALL_START"
- `toolCallId`: string
- `toolCallName`: string
- `parentMessageId`: string (optional)
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**TOOL_CALL_ARGS**
- `type`: "TOOL_CALL_ARGS"
- `toolCallId`: string
- `delta`: string (JSON fragment)
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**TOOL_CALL_END**
- `type`: "TOOL_CALL_END"
- `toolCallId`: string
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**TOOL_CALL_RESULT**
- `type`: "TOOL_CALL_RESULT"
- `messageId`: string
- `toolCallId`: string
- `content`: any
- `role`: string (typically "tool", optional)
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**TOOL_CALL_CHUNK** (convenience event)
- `toolCallId`: string (required on first chunk)
- `toolCallName`: string (required on first chunk)
- `parentMessageId`: string (optional)
- `delta`: string (optional JSON fragment)

## State Management Events

**STATE_SNAPSHOT**
- `type`: "STATE_SNAPSHOT"
- `snapshot`: object
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**STATE_DELTA**
- `type`: "STATE_DELTA"
- `delta`: array (RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations)
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**MESSAGES_SNAPSHOT**
- `type`: "MESSAGES_SNAPSHOT"
- `messages`: array
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

## Activity Events

**ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT**
- `type`: "ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT"
- `messageId`: string
- `activityType`: string ("PLAN", "SEARCH", etc.)
- `content`: object (structured JSON payload)
- `replace`: boolean (optional, defaults to true)
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

**ACTIVITY_DELTA**
- `type`: "ACTIVITY_DELTA"
- `messageId`: string
- `activityType`: string
- `patch`: array (RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations)
- `timestamp`: string (optional)

## Reasoning Events

**REASONING_START** / **REASONING_END**
- `messageId`: string

**REASONING_MESSAGE_START**
- `messageId`: string
- `role`: string ("assistant")

**REASONING_MESSAGE_CONTENT**
- `messageId`: string
- `delta`: string (non-empty)

**REASONING_MESSAGE_END**
- `messageId`: string

**REASONING_MESSAGE_CHUNK**
- `messageId`: string
- `delta`: string (empty string closes)

**REASONING_ENCRYPTED_VALUE**
- `subtype`: string ("message" or "tool-call")
- `entityId`: string
- `encryptedValue`: string

## Special Events

**RAW**
- `type`: "RAW"
- `event`: object (original event data)
- `source`: string (optional)

**CUSTOM**
- `type`: "CUSTOM"
- `name`: string
- `value`: any

## Draft Events

**META_EVENT**
- `metaType`: string (application-defined)
- `payload`: any (application-defined)

---

**Note**: The documentation describes events following "a streaming event-based architecture" with base properties (`type`, `timestamp`, `rawEvent`) shared across all events. SSE format implementation details were not explicitly specified in the provided content.
```

# A2UI Components and Structures

Based on the documentation provided, I can identify the following information:

## Mentioned Components
The page explicitly names these component types:
- **Text** - displays textual content
- **Button** - interactive clickable element
- **DateTimeInput** - date/time selection input
- **Card** - (implied in component gallery reference)
- **TextField** - (referenced in component gallery)
- **Image** - (referenced in component gallery)

## Surface Types
The documentation defines a surface as: *"Canvas for components (dialog, sidebar, main view)"* but doesn't enumerate specific surface type definitions.

## Data Model Format
Data is structured hierarchically using key-value mappings with paths. The example shows: `{ "key": "booking", "valueMap": [{ "key": "date", "valueString": "2025-12-16T19:00:00Z" }] }`

## Action Format
Actions reference event names passed to components. The structure shown: `"action": { "name": "confirm_booking" }` in v0.8, evolving to `"action": { "event": { "name": "confirm_booking" } }` in v0.9.

## Limitation
The page references a complete *"Component Gallery"* and *"Message Reference"* in separate documentation sections but doesn't list all available components. For comprehensive component details, you'd need to consult the [Component Gallery reference page](../../reference/components/).

Cohezion Genesis Engine.\n *\n * Bridges A2UI's declarative component catalog to React Three Fiber components.\n * Reads an experience script (JSON) and instantiates the corresponding R3F\n * components from a catalog of trusted implementations.\n *\n * Design: Security-first (no executable code in JSON), framework-native rendering.\n * Follows A2UI v0.9 simplified format.\n */\n\nimport React, { useMemo, useState, useCallback, useEffect } from \"react\";\nimport catalog from \"./catalog.json\";\n\n// --- Types matching A2UI spec ---\n\ninterface A2UIComponentInstance {\n  id: string;\n  component: string;\n  [key: string]: unknown; // component-specific props\n}\n\ninterface A2UIScene {\n  id: string;\n  description?: string;\n  duration: number | null;\n  trigger?: { type: string; target?: string };\n  transition?: { from: string; auto: boolean };\n  entryNarration?: string;\n  components: A2UIComponentInstance[];\n}\n\ninterface A2UIExperience {\n  experienceId: string;\n  version: string;\n  catalogRef: string;\n  description: string;\n  dataModel: Record<string, { type: string; initial: unknown }>;\n  scenes: A2UIScene[];\n}\n\n// --- Catalog validation ---\n\ntype CatalogDefinition = typeof catalog;\n\n/** Validates that a component type exists in the catalog */\nfunction isValidComponent(\n  componentType: string,\n  cat: CatalogDefinition\n): boolean {\n  return componentType in cat.components;\n}\n\n/** Validates an entire experience script against the catalog */\nexport function validateExperience(\n  experience: A2UIExperience,\n  cat: CatalogDefinition = catalog\n): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {\n  const errors: string[] = [];\n\n  for (const scene of experience.scenes) {\n    for (const comp of scene.components) {\n      if (!isValidComponent(comp.component, cat)) {\n        errors.push(\n          `Scene \"${scene.id}\": Unknown component \"${comp.component}\" (not in catalog)`\n        );\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Check scene transitions form a valid chain\n  const sceneIds = new Set(experience.scenes.map((s) => s.id));\n  for (const scene of experience.scenes) {\n    if (scene.transition?.from && !sceneIds.has(scene.transition.from)) {\n      errors.push(\n        `Scene \"${scene.id}\": Transition from unknown scene \"${scene.transition.from}\"`\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };\n}\n\n// --- Renderer state ---\n\ninterface RendererState {\n  currentSceneId: string;\n  dataModel: Record<string, unknown>;\n  sceneStartTime: number;\n  elapsed: number;\n}\n\n// --- Component registry (maps catalog names to React components) ---\n\ntype ComponentRenderer = React.FC<{\n  instance: A2UIComponentInstance;\n  state: RendererState;\n  onAction: (eventName: string, data?: unknown) => void;\n}>;\n\nconst componentRegistry: Record<string, ComponentRenderer> = {};\n\n/** Register a React component to render an A2UI catalog component */\nexport function registerComponent(\n  catalogName: string,\n  renderer: ComponentRenderer\n): void {\n  componentRegistry[catalogName] = renderer;\n}\n\n// --- A2UI Inspector (for agent testing) ---\n\nexport interface A2UIInspection {\n  experienceId: string;\n  currentScene: string;\n  activeComponents: Array<{\n    id: string;\n    component: string;\n    props: Record<string, unknown>;\n  }>;\n  dataModel: Record<string, unknown>;\n  elapsed: number;\n  catalogValid: boolean;\n}\n\n// --- Main Renderer ---\n\ninterface A2UIRendererProps {\n  experience: A2UIExperience;\n  onAction?: (eventName: string, data?: unknown) => void;\n  /** Expose inspection data for agent testing */\n  onInspect?: (inspection: A2UIInspection) => void;\n  /** Override initial scene */\n  initialScene?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function A2UIRenderer({\n  experience,\n  onAction,\n  onInspect,\n  initialScene,\n}: A2UIRendererProps) {\n  // Initialize data model from experience\n  const initialDataModel = useMemo(() => {\n    const model: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n    for (const [key, def] of Object.entries(experience.dataModel)) {\n      model[key] = def.initial;\n    }\n    return model;\n  }, [experience]);\n\n  const [state, setState] = useState<RendererState>({\n    currentSceneId: initialScene ?? experience.scenes[0]?.id ?? \"void\",\n    dataModel: initialDataModel,\n    sceneStartTime: Date.now(),\n    elapsed: 0,\n  });\n\n  // Find current scene\n  const currentScene = useMemo(\n    () => experience.scenes.find((s) => s.id === state.currentSceneId),\n    [experience, state.currentSceneId]\n  );\n\n  // Scene transition handler\n  const transitionTo = useCallback(\n    (sceneId: string) => {\n      setState((prev) => ({\n        ...prev,\n        currentSceneId: sceneId,\n        sceneStartTime: Date.now(),\n        elapsed: 0,\n      }));\n    },\n    []\n  );\n\n  // Action handler\n  const handleAction = useCallback(\n    (eventName: string, data?: unknown) => {\n      // Check if this action triggers a scene transition\n      const nextScene = experience.scenes.find(\n        (s) => s.trigger?.target && eventName === `${s.trigger.target}_click`\n      );\n      if (nextScene) {\n        // Find the scene AFTER current in the sequence\n        const currentIdx = experience.scenes.findIndex(\n          (s) => s.id === state.currentSceneId\n        );\n        if (currentIdx < experience.scenes.length - 1) {\n          transitionTo(experience.scenes[currentIdx + 1].id);\n        }\n      }\n      onAction?.(eventName, data);\n    },\n    [experience, state.currentSceneId, transitionTo, onAction]\n  );\n\n  // Auto-transition for timed scenes\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!currentScene?.duration) return;\n\n    const timer = setTimeout(() => {\n      const currentIdx = experience.scenes.findIndex(\n        (s) => s.id === state.currentSceneId\n      );\n      const nextScene = experience.scenes[currentIdx + 1];\n      if (nextScene?.transition?.auto) {\n        transitionTo(nextScene.id);\n      }\n    }, currentScene.duration);\n\n    return () => clearTimeout(timer);\n  }, [currentScene, experience, state.currentSceneId, transitionTo]);\n\n  // Expose inspection data\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!onInspect || !currentScene) return;\n\n    const inspection: A2UIInspection = {\n      experienceId: experience.experienceId,\n      currentScene: state.currentSceneId,\n      activeComponents: currentScene.components.map((c) => ({\n        id: c.id,\n        component: c.component,\n        props: Object.fromEntries(\n          Object.entries(c).filter(([k]) => k !== \"id\" && k !== \"component\")\n        ),\n      })),\n      dataModel: state.dataModel,\n      elapsed: (Date.now() - state.sceneStartTime) / 1000,\n      catalogValid: validateExperience(experience).valid,\n    };\n\n    onInspect(inspection);\n  }, [currentScene, experience, state, onInspect]);\n\n  // Render components for current scene\n  if (!currentScene) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"text-red-500 font-mono text-sm p-4\">\n        A2UI Error: Scene &quot;{state.currentSceneId}&quot; not found\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div data-a2ui-scene={currentScene.id} data-a2ui-experience={experience.experienceId}>\n      {currentScene.components.map((instance) => {\n        const Renderer = componentRegistry[instance.component];\n        if (!Renderer) {\n          // Unregistered component — render placeholder for development\n          return (\n            <div\n              key={instance.id}\n              data-a2ui-component={instance.component}\n              data-a2ui-id={instance.id}\n              className=\"text-yellow-500 font-mono text-[10px] p-1\"\n            >\n              [{instance.component}: {instance.id}]\n            </div>\n          );\n        }\n        return (\n          <Renderer\n            key={instance.id}\n            instance={instance}\n            state={state}\n            onAction={handleAction}\n          />\n        );\n      })}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\nRENDERER_EOF\necho \"Created A2UIRenderer.tsx\"",
  "description": "Create A2UI Renderer component"

Lifecycle\n    RUN_STARTED = \"RUN_STARTED\"\n    RUN_FINISHED = \"RUN_FINISHED\"\n    RUN_ERROR = \"RUN_ERROR\"\n    STEP_STARTED = \"STEP_STARTED\"\n    STEP_FINISHED = \"STEP_FINISHED\"\n\n    # Text messages (narration)\n    TEXT_MESSAGE_START = \"TEXT_MESSAGE_START\"\n    TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT = \"TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT\"\n    TEXT_MESSAGE_END = \"TEXT_MESSAGE_END\"\n\n    # Tool calls (phase transitions)\n    TOOL_CALL_START = \"TOOL_CALL_START\"\n    TOOL_CALL_ARGS = \"TOOL_CALL_ARGS\"\n    TOOL_CALL_END = \"TOOL_CALL_END\"\n    TOOL_CALL_RESULT = \"TOOL_CALL_RESULT\"\n\n    # State management (universe ticks)\n    STATE_SNAPSHOT = \"STATE_SNAPSHOT\"\n    STATE_DELTA = \"STATE_DELTA\"\n\n    # Custom (Cohezion-specific)\n    CUSTOM = \"CUSTOM\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass AGUIEvent:\n    \"\"\"Base AG-UI event following the protocol specification.\"\"\"\n\n    type: AGUIEventType\n    timestamp: str = field(default_factory=lambda: time.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\", time.gmtime()))\n\n    def to_sse(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Format as SSE (Server-Sent Events) data line.\"\"\"\n        return f\"data: {self.to_json()}\\n\\n\"\n\n    def to_json(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Serialize to JSON string.\"\"\"\n        d = {\"type\": self.type.value, \"timestamp\": self.timestamp}\n        d.update(self._extra_fields())\n        return json.dumps(d)\n\n    def _extra_fields(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {}\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass RunStartedEvent(AGUIEvent):\n    \"\"\"Emitted when the Genesis cosmogony begins.\"\"\"\n\n    type: AGUIEventType = AGUIEventType.RUN_STARTED\n    thread_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))\n    run_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))\n\n    def _extra_fields(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"threadId\": self.thread_id, \"runId\": self.run_id}\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass RunFinishedEvent(AGUIEvent):\n    \"\"\"Emitted when the cosmogony animation completes.\"\"\"\n\n    type: AGUIEventType = AGUIEventType.RUN_FINISHED\n    thread_id: str = \"\"\n    run_id: str = \"\"\n    result: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n    def _extra_fields(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"threadId\": self.thread_id, \"runId\": self.run_id, \"result\": self.result}\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass TextMessageEvent(AGUIEvent):\n    \"\"\"Narration text streaming event.\"\"\"\n\n    message_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))\n    role: str = \"assistant\"\n    delta: str = \"\"\n\n    def _extra_fields(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        d: dict[str, Any] = {\"messageId\": self.message_id, \"role\": self.role}\n        if self.delta:\n            d[\"delta\"] = self.delta\n        return d\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ToolCallEvent(AGUIEvent):\n    \"\"\"Phase transition event (mapped to AG-UI tool calls).\"\"\"\n\n    tool_call_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))\n    tool_call_name: str = \"\"\n    content: Any = None\n\n    def _extra_fields(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        d: dict[str, Any] = {\n            \"toolCallId\": self.tool_call_id,\n            \"toolCallName\": self.tool_call_name,\n        }\n        if self.content is not None:\n            d[\"content\"] = self.content\n        return d\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass StateSnapshotEvent(AGUIEvent):\n    \"\"\"Full universe state snapshot.\"\"\"\n\n    type: AGUIEventType = AGUIEventType.STATE_SNAPSHOT\n    snapshot: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n    def _extra_fields(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"snapshot\": self.snapshot}\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass StateDeltaEvent(AGUIEvent):\n    \"\"\"Incremental universe state update (RFC 6902 JSON Patch).\"\"\"\n\n    type: AGUIEventType = AGUIEventType.STATE_DELTA\n    delta: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    def _extra_fields(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"delta\": self.delta}\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CustomEvent(AGUIEvent):\n    \"\"\"Cohezion-specific event (e.g., HIHO coherence update).\"\"\"\n\n    type: AGUIEventType = AGUIEventType.CUSTOM\n    name: str = \"\"\n    value: Any = None\n\n    def _extra_fields(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"name\": self.name, \"value\": self.value}\n\n\n# --- Convenience constructors for Genesis events ---\n\n\ndef narration_event(text: str, stage: str) -> list[AGUIEvent]:\n    \"\"\"Create a TEXT_MESSAGE sequence for a narration stage.\"\"\"\n    msg_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n    return [\n        TextMessageEvent(type=AGUIEventType.TEXT_MESSAGE_START, message_id=msg_id, role=\"assistant\"),\n        TextMessageEvent(type=AGUIEventType.TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT, message_id=msg_id, delta=text),\n        TextMessageEvent(type=AGUIEventType.TEXT_MESSAGE_END, message_id=msg_id),\n    ]\n\n\ndef phase_transition_event(from_sym: str, to_sym: str, temperature: float) -> list[AGUIEvent]:\n    \"\"\"Create a TOOL_CALL sequence for a symmetry breaking transition.\"\"\"\n    call_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n    return [\n        ToolCallEvent(\n            type=AGUIEventType.TOOL_CALL_START,\n            tool_call_id=call_id,\n            tool_call_name=\"symmetry_breaking\",\n        ),\n        ToolCallEvent(\n            type=AGUIEventType.TOOL_CALL_RESULT,\n            tool_call_id=call_id,\n            tool_call_name=\"symmetry_breaking\",\n            content={\n                \"from\": from_sym,\n                \"to\": to_sym,\n                \"temperature\": temperature,\n                \"stage\": f\"{from_sym} → {to_sym}\",\n            },\n        ),\n    ]\n\n\ndef universe_tick_event(\n    temperature: float,\n    symmetry: str,\n    coherence: float,\n    order_parameter: float,\n    landau_free_energy: float,\n) -> StateDeltaEvent:\n    \"\"\"Create a STATE_DELTA for a universe tick update.\"\"\"\n    return StateDeltaEvent(\n        delta=[\n            {\"op\": \"replace\", \"path\": \"/temperature\", \"value\": temperature},\n            {\"op\": \"replace\", \"path\": \"/symmetry\", \"value\": symmetry},\n            {\"op\": \"replace\", \"path\": \"/coherence\", \"value\": coherence},\n            {\"op\": \"replace\", \"path\": \"/orderParameter\", \"value\": order_parameter},\n            {\"op\": \"replace\", \"path\": \"/landauFreeEnergy\", \"value\": landau_free_energy},\n        ]\n    )\nAGUI_EOF\necho \"Created agui_events.py\"",

Brahmagupta's zero gave nothing a name.\",\n    \"HIHO\": \"At the still point, the dance began. Half in, half out. The balance that creates.\",\n}\n\n\ndef compute_cosmogony(temperature: float) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Compute Landau cosmogony state for a given temperature.\"\"\"\n    stage_idx = 0\n    for i, tc in enumerate(CRITICAL_TEMPS):\n        if temperature < tc:\n            stage_idx = i + 1\n\n    symmetry = SYMMETRIES[stage_idx]\n\n    a, b = 1.0, 0.5\n    critical_temp = CRITICAL_TEMPS[max(0, stage_idx - 1)] if stage_idx > 0 else 100.0\n    order_param = (\n        math.sqrt(a * (critical_temp - temperature) / (2 * b))\n        if temperature < critical_temp\n        else 0.0\n    )\n    landau_fe = (\n        a * (temperature - critical_temp) * order_param**2 + b * order_param**4\n        if order_param > 0\n        else 0.0\n    )\n\n    closest_tc = min(CRITICAL_TEMPS, key=lambda tc: abs(tc - temperature))\n    fisher_eig = 1 / (abs(temperature - closest_tc) + 0.01) if closest_tc > 0 else 0.0\n\n    coherence = 1.0 - abs(order_param - 0.5) * 2 if order_param > 0 else 0.0\n\n    return {\n        \"temperature\": temperature,\n        \"symmetry\": symmetry,\n        \"stage\": stage_idx - 1,\n        \"orderParameter\": order_param,\n        \"landauFreeEnergy\": landau_fe,\n        \"fisherEigenvalue\": fisher_eig,\n        \"coherence\": coherence,\n    }\n\n\nasync def cosmogony_stream() -> AsyncIterator[str]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Stream the Genesis cosmogony as AG-UI typed events.\n\n    Simulates the 10-second cooling animation from T=200 to T=0.01,\n    emitting state deltas, phase transitions, and narration events.\n    \"\"\"\n    # --- RUN_STARTED ---\n    run = RunStartedEvent()\n    yield run.to_sse()\n\n    # --- Initial state snapshot ---\n    initial = compute_cosmogony(200.0)\n    yield StateSnapshotEvent(snapshot=initial).to_sse()\n\n    # 100ms per tick\n    prev_symmetry = \"void\"\n\n    for i in range(num_ticks):\n        progress = (i + 1) / num_ticks\n        # Exponential cooling: T = T_start * (T_end/T_start)^progress\n        temperature = t_start * (t_end / t_start) ** progress\n\n        state = compute_cosmogony(temperature)\n\n        # Emit state delta\n        yield universe_tick_event(\n            temperature=state[\"temperature\"],\n            symmetry=state[\"symmetry\"],\n            coherence=state[\"coherence\"],\n            order_parameter=state[\"orderParameter\"],\n            landau_free_energy=state[\"landauFreeEnergy\"],\n        ).to_sse()\n\n        # Check for phase transition\n        if state[\"symmetry\"] != prev_symmetry:\n            # Emit phase transition tool call\n            for event in phase_transition_event(prev_symmetry, state[\"symmetry\"], temperature):\n                yield event.to_sse()\n\n            # Emit narration for new phase\n            narration = NARRATIONS.get(state[\"symmetry\"], \"\")\n            if narration:\n                for event in narration_event(narration, state[\"symmetry\"]):\n                    yield event.to_sse()\n\n            prev_symmetry = state[\"symmetry\"]\n\n        await asyncio.sleep(tick_interval)\n\n    # --- HIHO coherence event ---\n    yield CustomEvent(\n        name=\"hiho_equilibrium\",\n        value={\"coherence\": 0.5, \"description\": \"Half-In, Half-Out equilibrium reached\"},\n    ).to_sse()\n\n    # --- RUN_FINISHED ---\n    yield RunFinishedEvent(\n        thread_id=run.thread_id,\n        run_id=run.run_id,\n        result={\"finalSymmetry\": \"HIHO\", \"finalTemperature\": 0.01},\n    ).to_sse()\n\n\n@agui_router.get(\"/stream\")\nasync def stream_cosmogony():\n    \"\"\"\n    Stream the Genesis cosmogony as AG-UI typed SSE events.\n\n    Returns a Server-Sent Events stream with typed AG-UI events:\n    - RUN_STARTED / RUN_FINISHED (lifecycle)\n    - STATE_SNAPSHOT / STATE_DELTA (universe state)\n    - TEXT_MESSAGE_* (narration)\n    - TOOL_CALL_* (phase transitions)\n    - CUSTOM (HIHO equilibrium)\n    \"\"\"\n    return StreamingResponse(\n        cosmogony_stream(),\n        media_type=\"text/event-stream\",\n        headers={\n            \"Cache-Control\": \"no-cache\",\n            \"Connection\": \"keep-alive\",\n            \"X-Accel-Buffering\": \"no\",\n            \"Access-Control-Allow-Origin\": \"*\",\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@agui_router.get(\"/catalog\")\nasync def get_a2ui_catalog():\n    \"\"\"Return the A2UI component catalog for agent inspection.\"\"\"\n    import json\n    from pathlib import Path\n\n    catalog_path = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent.parent / \"web\" / \"anima_dashboard\" / \"src\" / \"a2ui\" / \"catalog.json\"\n    if catalog_path.exists():\n        return json.loads(catalog_path.read_text())\n    return {\"error\": \"Catalog not found\", \"path\": str(catalog_path)}\nROUTE_EOF\necho \"Created agui.py SSE endpoint\"",

|----------|--------|

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**What makes this implementation special:** Cohezion is now one of the first projects implementing 4 of 6 Google agent protocols. The A2UI catalog means any agent can inspect the Genesis experience as JSON data (not opaque WebGL), and the AG-UI endpoint streams physics simulation state as protocol-compliant typed events. This makes the entire cosmogony animation agent-testable and agent-composable.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

<div\n    data-a2ui-id={instance.id}\n    data-a2ui-component=\"cohezion-sound-engine\"\n    data-phase={instance.phase as string}\n    data-muted={String(instance.muted)}\n    className=\"hidden\" // </div>\n));\n\nregisterComponent(\"cohezion-equation-panel\", ({ instance }) => (\n  <div\n    data-a2ui-id={instance.id}\n    data-a2ui-component=\"cohezion-equation-panel\"\n    className=\"font-mono text-xs text-green-400\"\n  >\n    [{instance.title as string}]\n  </div>\n));\n\nregisterComponent(\"cohezion-temperature-slider\", ({ instance, onAction }) => (\n  <div\n    data-a2ui-id={instance.id}\n    data-a2ui-component=\"cohezion-temperature-slider\"\n  >\n    <input\n      type=\"range\"\n      min={Number(instance.min) || 0.005}\n      max={Number(instance.max)
